title: centaurea tenuifolia subsp. pinae
intro: Centaurea tenuifolia subsp. pinae, commonly known as Piny St. John's Wort, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Piny St. John's Wort include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and vulnerary actions, which contribute to its wound-healing properties and ability to reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
